categories.label: Higher of Sun and Moon (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Tied players: the one whose other marker is closest to the lower one wins, i.e. the lowest higher total.

tiebreakers.description: Tied players: the player whose other (higher) Score marker is closest to the lower one wins
If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: dual-track-minimum (Knizia-style). Sun and Moon points are tracked on the score track during play; at game end Llamas are split between Sun and Moon via the Main board conversion chart (chart values not read, so the scorer enters the converted points). Solo mode (vs the Ayllu) uses the same final-score rule and is not modelled separately.
